name: vegferd-no
description: Vegferd tells you what the drive you are about to make will be like, from public Norwegian data: the traffic on the way into the city, the road conditions over the mountain on the way to the cabin, and the ferries in between. Much of Norway's road network runs on ferries, so Vegferd watches them continuously and tells you the next departure on every crossing of your trip, with delays and cancellations as they happen. It reports road conditions, not weather: closed roads, convoy driving, what the road-side stations measure, and what it will be like where you pass. Many of us drive electric, so it finds charging stations along the route. Routes are computed on Vegferd's own road network, built on top of the Norwegian Public Roads Administration's road data, with tolls and ferry fares added up. Norway only. In ChatGPT, Vegferd plans the trip and answers questions about it.

interface.longDescription:
Vegferd tells you what the drive you are about to make will be like, from public Norwegian data: the traffic on the way into the city, the road conditions over the mountain on the way to the cabin, and the ferries in between. In ChatGPT, Vegferd plans the trip and answers questions about it.

Ferries. Much of Norway's road network runs on ferries, so Vegferd watches them continuously. Ask when the next ferry leaves from a quay, or plan a drive and get the departure you will catch on every crossing, the wait at the quay, and delays and cancellations as they happen.

Road conditions, not weather. Ask whether a mountain pass is closed or under convoy driving, what the road-side stations measure right now, and what the conditions will be where you pass, at the time you pass. Closed roads and the Public Roads Administration's traffic messages are part of the plan.

Traffic. Ask whether there is more traffic than usual on the route, stretch by stretch, compared with a normal day at that hour.

Electric. Many of us drive electric, so Vegferd finds the charging stations along the route, in driving order, together with rest areas and other stops.

Cost and alternatives. Ask what the trip costs in tolls and ferry fares, and for the other ways to go: shortest, without tolls, without ferries, or over another mountain pass.

Routes are computed on Vegferd's own road network, built on top of the Norwegian Public Roads Administration's road data. Live data comes from Statens vegvesen, Entur, the Norwegian Meteorological Institute, Kartverket and NOBIL. Every answer names its sources and how old the data is.

Norway only. You sign in with your Vegferd account, the same one as in the app. Vegferd does not store what you ask; see vegferd.no/ai-privacy.
capabilities: Plan a drive in Norway with the ferry crossings, closed roads and mountain passes in the plan
Next car-ferry departures from a quay, with delays and cancellations as they happen
Whether a mountain pass is closed or under convoy driving, and what the road-side stations measure
Road conditions along a planned route at the time you pass each point, with official warnings
Traffic on a planned route now, stretch by stretch, compared with a normal day at that hour
Charging stations, rest areas and other stops along a planned route, in driving order
Tolls and ferry fares for a planned route, and height restrictions on the way
The other ways to go: shortest, without tolls, without ferries, or over another mountain pass
Find places in Norway: place names, addresses, businesses, charging stations and ferry quays
defaultPrompt: Når går neste ferje fra Halhjem?
Hvor lang tid tar Bergen–Ålesund i morgen kl. 7?

positive.description: Next ferry departures and live status for a named crossing.
positive.prompt: When is the next ferry from Halhjem to Sandvikvåg?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the next departures from Halhjem to Sandvikvåg with times and any delay or cancellation, and names Entur as the source with the time the data was fetched.

positive.description: Plan a drive that includes a ferry, departing at a given time.
positive.prompt: How long does it take to drive from Bergen to Ålesund if I leave tomorrow at 7am?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the driving time, distance and expected arrival, names the ferry crossings on the route with the next departure, and mentions any closures or mountain passes along the way.

positive.description: Status of a named mountain pass right now.
positive.expected_behavior: Says whether the Norwegian Public Roads Administration reports the pass closed, under convoy driving or with other messages, and when it has no messages says so without claiming the road is open.

positive.description: Weather along a route, as a follow-up to a planned trip.
positive.prompt: Plan a drive from Oslo to Trondheim and tell me what the weather will be like along the way.
positive.expected_behavior: Plans the route, then gives the road conditions and weather at the start, over the mountain passes and at the destination at the time the car passes each point, including any official weather warnings.

positive.description: Find a street address and the cost of driving there.
positive.prompt: What does it cost in tolls and ferries to drive from Stavanger to Olav Kyrres gate 4, 5014 Bergen?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the address in Bergen, plans the route and gives the estimated toll total and ferry fare for a passenger car, naming the source.

negative.description: Do not trigger for flights: Vegferd covers driving and ferries, not air travel. ChatGPT answers without the plugin.
negative.prompt: What are the cheapest flights from Oslo to Bergen next weekend?

negative.description: Do not trigger for driving routes outside Norway: the routing and road data cover Norway only. ChatGPT answers without the plugin.
negative.prompt: What's the fastest way to drive from Paris to Berlin?

negative.description: Do not trigger for hotel or accommodation booking: Vegferd does not search for or book accommodation. ChatGPT answers without the plugin.
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel room in Tromsø for Friday night.

review.commerce_description: Vegferd does not sell anything or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Plan a drive in Norway with the ferries, road conditions, traffic, charging stations and costs on the way. A planned trip is shown on Vegferd's own map inside the conversation: the route on Kartverket's map of Norway, with the ferry crossings, mountain passes, closed stretches and stops. You sign in with your Vegferd account on konto.vegferd.no.
